lead: A guide for teachers who want to use these free space labs in class, from Class 6 to Class 12. It matches each lab to a textbook chapter and gives ready lesson plans.
try: Under Which lab for which chapter, click your class, such as Class 8, to see which lab goes with each chapter. Then open a plan under Ready lesson plans.
points: One lab fits into a single lesson of 40 minutes: a warm-up guess, exploring in pairs, a class talk, a short quiz on paper, and homework.
Only one screen? Every lab works on a projector. The teacher moves the sliders while the class calls out what to try.
There are no accounts and the labs collect no data about students. With poor internet, you can download every lab once and use them offline.
